question: How can an exact-target native module insert a system notification with custom title, body, and image paths?
callsite_evidence: sub_CA81F10 is identified by its own log string as lvx_notification_insert_message and has 24 direct system-app callsites
weather sub_C5DE7C8 and recorder sub_C5F3DBC zero an 88-byte writable message, populate title/body/icon fields through one-field setters, then call sub_CA81F10
sedentary reminder sub_C4B28AC sets title +12, source/category +16, body +20, small icon +28, large notification image +32, reminder byte +80, callbacks +72/+76, and inserts the message
sub_CA81500 allocates an 88-byte internal copy and deep-copies supplied string fields, defaulting missing +28/+32 paths to stock notification assets
control_flow_evidence: sub_CA81E28 writes pointer +12, sub_CA81E38 writes +16, and sub_CA81E48 writes +20
sub_CA81E58 writes image path +28 and sub_CA81E68 writes image path +32
sub_CA81E98 writes reminder flag +80; sub_CA81EF0/sub_CA81F00 write callbacks +72/+76
insert clones the message, appends it to notification-manager state, emits event 32 when a reminder is requested, and returns zero or one on observed paths
ownership_analysis: The caller owns the 88-byte input and its strings for the duration of the call. The notification manager allocates its own message and deep-copies string paths/text before returning. Image bytes are not copied: +28/+32 remain paths opened later by the notification UI, so the first-frame PNG must remain at a stable target-visible filesystem path.
unsafe_assumptions: the device accepted Manager registration and navigation and rendered the replacement first-frame PNG; animated GIF rendering is not supported by this notification path
the exact distinction between +28 small/app icon and +32 large/content image is inferred from weather, recorder, and activity callsites
notification insertion runs from the /dev/canopus write callback in miwear context and the static PNG path is device-proven
recommended_probe: Device probe passed with title 'Canopus', body 'Canpous Loaded! Just ENJOY~', and +28/+32 both pointing to persistent /data/canopus/manager_loaded.png. Keep the first-frame PNG staged before insertion; do not restore the unsupported animated GIF path.
